items.title: Adrian Cunningham interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 31, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Good to be here, Monk. Thanks for having me.

ctx.x: Adrian was interviewed via Zoom on March 31, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and I am in Hamilton College in Clinton, New York, and I’m talking to Adrian Cunningham in Harlem. Welcome.
Good to be here, Monk. Thanks for having me.
